label: GO after a rewarded rare a1 trial (a1->S2, reward) when the agent is about to repeat a1
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (D1 and D2 essentially never). The core condition is the previous trial: chose a1, rare transition to S2, rewarded (prev_action==1 & prev_common==0 & prev_reward==1 covers ~90% of activations and ~91% of mass, but only 46% precision). Precision rises to ~0.73 when restricted to GO steps where the model policy picks a1 (model_act==1), i.e. the agent is about to stay with a1 rather than make the model-based switch to a2; dev F1 0.77, mass recall 0.88. All variables are observed (previous trial outcome) or the agents own policy output at this step; no future random outcomes. Using choice logit > 1 instead of model_act gives similar F1 (0.78). Magnitude: weakest activations are least covered (62% of lowest quartile vs 91% of top quartile); many misses are GO steps on the windows first trial where the previous trial is outside the window (prev unknown), plus scattered low activations at GO with a1 chosen after other histories. Does not fire after a2 choices, after common transitions, or after unrewarded trials. Also correlates with high value (7.7-8.1 bin).
